author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
Dame Nawal Shafiq-Barclay: patron of history and its forgotten artifacts, owner of the hungry Osiris, and part-time spy for the Lombardi sisters. 
As portrayed by Necar Zadegan, and here joined by Troy Baker and Alessandra Mastronardi. (Kyle Klütz, Director of Photography)
title: Meeting Dame Nawal | Indiana Jones and the Great Circle #indianajones #thegreatcircle #gaming
